scope: Current movers direction; other eight directions remain exploration prototypes
method: Real DOM buttons, native pointer and keyboard actions in the Codex in-app browser through CUA; screenshots from the actual running game

checks.name: Fresh briefing and start
checks.evidence: First QA game started at 0/3 with the client letter, control instructions and enabled start button after assets loaded.

checks.name: Actual cargo physics and delivery
checks.evidence: Pointer pickup and transport of all nine cargo items; each contract reached visible 3/3 and its own result screen. Light, heavy and fragile items traversed real ramps and obstacles.

checks.name: Fragile failure and checkpoint recovery
checks.evidence: After delivering the first box, throwing the fragile item damaged packaging. Repair retained 1/3 delivery, allowed continuation and produced evaluation 86.

checks.name: Three contracts and personal responses
checks.evidence: Lin Xia / sunny courtyard, Chen Shu / rain, Zhou Ayi / night completed in order with distinct thank-you letters. The last result stated 今天，三处灯亮了。

checks.name: Records and refresh
checks.evidence: Three visible record articles retained evaluations 86, 100 and 100 after refresh; records can be opened and returned from.

checks.name: Keyboard and replay
checks.evidence: Current-contract practice button restored cargo. Space visibly put the worker in the air; E picked up the photo box and changed the action label to 轻放.

checks.name: Pause and resume
checks.evidence: Paused while carrying a sofa in the third contract. Delivery count remained 1/3 across the pause; resuming completed delivery.

checks.name: Mobile layout and real input
checks.evidence: Third-contract pointer pickups and transport completed on the mobile viewport. Record content scrolls while the return button stays visible. Temporary viewport override was reset.

checks.name: Fullscreen entry and exit
checks.evidence: Button changes to 退出大画面 and exits on the next click. Sound and restart controls remain inside fullscreen. Visible canvas rectangle was within the fullscreen game bounds.

checks.name: Focus after switching
checks.evidence: Loaded detective first, then movers; opening and closing the client letter returned focus to the movers canvas rather than a cached canvas from another game.

checks.name: Embedded product controls
checks.evidence: The embedded URL showed sound and restart controls inside the game toolbar. The actual sound button switched 开 / 关 in the visible interface.

checks.name: Nine-direction switching regression
checks.evidence: Each selection showed one visible canvas and a valid game title with no game-loading error. Moving Day panels stayed hidden in the other eight directions.

checks.name: Missing artwork recovery
checks.evidence: An isolated copy on port 8963 deliberately omitted fridge.webp. The game displayed a retry button instead of an endless spinner. Restoring the asset and clicking 重新加载场景 returned to the complete first briefing; production files were untouched.

checks.name: Artwork preparation
checks.evidence: Regenerated runtime WebP files from six preserved ImageGen sources; checked transparent worker frames and fixed feet baseline.

checks.name: Repository catalog
checks.evidence: scripts/projects.py check confirmed 15 projects and matching catalog / README.

checks.name: Static build
checks.evidence: scripts/build_site.py built 15 static demos; the Moving Day scene thumbnail and all 14 WebP assets are included. Original artwork and temporary QA files stay outside the public build.

limitations: No human playtesting, emotional response, retention or commercial success measurement.
Three short contracts reuse the moving structure; long-term content, branching dialogue and interior destination scenes are not implemented.
Desktop and 390x844 mobile checked in the in-app browser; broad browser/device QA and auditory quality evaluation remain outstanding.
The 20-second asset timeout is implemented; the tested loading failure was an actual missing-file response, not a deliberately stalled connection.
Only direction switching was rechecked for the other eight prototypes in this round; earlier full-game checks describe their own historical versions.
temporaryTestCleanup: Test browser tabs closed and port 8963 stopped. Recursive deletion of the isolated QA directory was rejected by automatic policy review; the directory remains outside web and the public build.
